title: Beyond Uncertainty: Establishing the Oda Strategy for the Treatment of Acute Aortic Dissection
content: Significant progress has been achieved in the treatment of acute aortic dissection over the past 90 years, following the first surgical intervention. This review pays tribute to the dedication of pioneers and innovators who developed advanced medical devices and therapeutic strategies to address this challenging condition. While navigating uncertainties in treatment optimization, the primary focus remains on saving lives by increasing survival rates during the acute phase and preventing aorta-related lethal events and late thoracoabdominal aortic replacements. A strategy for managing this disease was established in 2013, demonstrating excellent early and long-term outcomes. From a fair and neutral standpoint, this review traces over 90 years of progress in treating acute aortic dissection. It outlines the journey that led to the establishment of the Oda strategy as the optimal approach and provides valuable insights for exceptional cardiovascular surgeons who will be utilizing this strategy in the future. We hope that as many patients as possible will benefit from this strategy and will receive treatment rationally, without over- or under-treatment.
